scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && git branch -f gh-pages HEAD && rm -rf /tmp/gh-pages-dist && git worktree add /tmp/gh-pages-dist gh-pages && cp -r dist/* /tmp/gh-pages-dist/ && git -C /tmp/gh-pages-dist add -A && git -C /tmp/gh-pages-dist -c user.name=archbtw -c user.email=archbtw@localhost commit -q -m "deploy: pages build $(date +%F)" && git push origin gh-pages --force && git worktree remove /tmp/gh-pages-dist --force
